# FutureShell WebAssembly site

Serve this directory over HTTP or HTTPS, then open `index.html`.
For a local test, run `python3 -m http.server 8000` here and visit `http://localhost:8000`. The browser loads `futureshell.wasm` on startup and opens DT first. Future Browser can load `http://localhost:8000/tic-tac-toe.webasm.bin`.

The editable sources are under `../../../source/phoneapps/htmldemo`, and the matching RAD-TUI forms are under `../../../source/phoneapps`.
